Forms

  • Approved Program Verification - This verification form is to be completed by the college where the state approved program was completed.
  • Waiver Affidavit - The waiver affidavit form needs to be submitted to the Certification Office by the Superintendent only, if a waiver is required to hire a teacher who is ineligible for a certificate.
  • List of Certificate Endorsement Codes and Levels
  • Ed Tech Upgrade Form - Fill out and send in this form with Application ET Upgrade
  • Teacher Rubric - This form is for those who choose option 3 for meeting the praxis requirement. It is important to note that this portfolio only meets the praxis requirement, and not the coursework requirement.
  • 093 School Psychologist Application Packet - This packet is for those applying for the 093 endorsement only.
  • Library 071 Portfolio Rubric - This document provides the guidelines for library portfolio requirement.
  • Mentorship Guidelines - This document provides the guidelines for Administrator Mentorship.
